analysis.ablation_rule: a capability whose ablation is not worse than FULL (bootstrap interval of FULL - ablation includes or lies below 0) is reported UNJUSTIFIED_ON_THIS_PILOT
analysis.ablations: paired by world set: FULL minus each ablation; mean, cluster-bootstrap 95% interval (2000, seed 0) and an exact-in-distribution paired sign-flip randomization p (20000 flips, seed 0), per kind and pooled; no multiplicity correction is claimed (exploratory)
analysis.fda05_exposure: count of Mind 'indistinguishable' answers (the vacuous-pair defect FDA-05 is unrepaired)
analysis.lift: analysis.lift_decision(records, candidate, grid=pilot grid) per Mind variant -- exploratory by construction (not the formal grid); reported as indicative, never as a claim
analysis.no_strong_baseline: discoverable credit split by truth_in_searched_family; out-of-family worlds are NO_STRONG_BASELINE (capped in lift_decision)
analysis.predictions: every executed query with a sealed mixture prediction: mean log predictive density of ln y, PIT-based 90% central-interval coverage; reported per variant and kind, apart from credit
analysis.primary: mean campaign credit over world sets (v0.2 PRIMARY endpoint), per arm
analysis.replay: every FULL trace replayed from its recorded observations; status VERIFIED required

grid.master: benchmarks.genesis_lite.pilot.master_for(root, i, presentation, seed) -- one master per world set, shared by every arm

limits: not the preregistered formal grid; no formal or maturity claim
FDA-05 / FDA-06 / O-1 unrepaired (scoring cannot be frozen)
Genesis A1 not passed; this pilot runs under owner exception EXC-MIND-1
the Mind was developed on development worlds from the same generator (other seeds)
